_comment: SWEG_STAGING — the faction-neutral threat-range-aware commit heuristic (the closing-side counterpart of the adopted ranged-hold family). An artificial-intelligence piloting heuristic, not a 10e rules claim: it grounds in the core-rules fact that Advancing forfeits the charge (quoted below) and in the universal competitive staging doctrine, and is registered so the citation auditor tracks it. Default-off, byte-identical off. PRINCIPLE-2 ARMY-SCOPED ENTRY POINTS (2026-07-03): the capstone proved this faction-neutral lever washes / regresses the headline metric generically (the durable side banks the same symmetric staging), so four default-off army-scoped entry points share the SAME logic on the SAME code path via Battle._scoped_lever_on: SWEG_AM_STAGING (Astra Militarum), SWEG_ORKS_STAGING (Orks), SWEG_SOROR_STAGING (Adepta Sororitas) and SWEG_GSC_STAGING (Genestealer Cults). The recipe is the one proven by simulator.am_advance_discipline (+5.75), simulator.ck_ranged_hold (+11.27), simulator.votann_ranged_hold (+10.37) and simulator.am_secondary_pursuit (+5.17): a faithful universal lever that over-poles bank symmetrically is scoped to the built-for faction. Each scoped gate reads the ACTIVE army's faction (army.units[0].profile.faction), so only the scoped army's own move phase precomputes an envelope and stages — the scope is asymmetric by construction. Every scoped gate is default-off; when none is set (and SWEG_STAGING unset) the OFF path is byte-identical.

simulator.staging_discipline.rule_name: Advance move + Charge phase eligibility (10e Core Rules) — threat-range staging piloting heuristic
simulator.staging_discipline.quoted_text: If a unit Advances, then until the end of the turn, that unit cannot shoot or declare a charge. ... A unit cannot be selected to declare a charge if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.
simulator.staging_discipline.trigger: SWEG_STAGING=1, OR the acting army's Principle-2 scoped gate = 1 (SWEG_AM_STAGING / SWEG_ORKS_STAGING / SWEG_SOROR_STAGING / SWEG_GSC_STAGING, all default-off; unset is the byte-identical kill-switch and the universal gate keeps its exact prior semantics); a moving unit with an ENGAGE / CAPTURE / STEAL move intent, not cheap chaff (per strategy._is_chaff_unit), whose would-be sprint destination (a full Normal move plus a full Advance toward its goal) ends inside a significant enemy threat envelope (an enemy of expected damage per activation >= 2.0, envelope radius = enemy Move + max(weapon range, charge reach) capped at 30 inches), that CANNOT accomplish its commit this turn (a melee unit whose nearest enemy is beyond a Normal move plus a charge; an objective claimer that cannot reach the marker even by Advancing; a ranged unit whose nearest enemy is beyond its own range after a Normal move), and for whose binding envelope no friendly mass is committing this turn (friendly expected output already poised inside the envelope at phase start < 0.5 of the local enemy output)
simulator.staging_discipline.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; grounds in the core-rules fact quoted above that Advancing forfeits both shooting and the charge, and in the universal competitive staging doctrine (Stat Check: stage an objective within the enemy's threat range while the unit itself stays outside that threat range, then commit together rather than trickling in piecemeal). The default move logic Advances any unit that cannot reach its goal within a Normal move, so opponents Advance everything into a gunline kill zone on turn 1 and deliver themselves piecemeal (World Eaters Berzerkers Advance forfeiting their charge and die before acting; ~100 Ork units Advance turn 1). When SWEG_STAGING=1 such a wasted commit STAGES instead: the Advance sprint is suppressed (Battle._do_move's shared advance-suppression, the same path as simulator.am_advance_discipline / ck_ranged_hold / votann_ranged_hold) so a melee closer keeps its charge for when it arrives, and for a melee-delivery envelope the Normal move is capped at the bubble edge (Battle._staging_capped_target ray-sphere) so the unit does not walk into an enemy charge it cannot answer. The unit STILL Normal-moves toward its goal every turn (board presence is never surrendered — the officer-front-line -2.19 and screen / gunline-hold rejections that made units passive are the cautionary precedents), so staging delays only the reckless piecemeal ENGAGEMENT over-commit. THREE overrides preserve mission play and coordination: (a) a unit that claims / contests an objective this turn or can charge / shoot this turn commits freely (the fall-back-only-when-wasted precedent); (b) cheap chaff / screens are exempt (screens are supposed to be exposed); (c) when a friendly mass is already poised inside the same envelope (commit_ready, computed once per phase from the phase-start snapshot with no per-activation lookahead), the whole cluster releases and commits together. The threat envelope, commit-mass, and can-act tests are all deterministic geometry over cached expected damage per activation (code.roles.expected_ranged_dpa / expected_melee_dpa); no random draw is made, so the OFF path (gate unset → the per-phase precompute returns None → the _do_move staging block is skipped) reproduces the baseline byte-for-byte. FACTION-NEUTRAL by design (the closing side's counterpart of the gunline-hold family): the envelope radius is CAPPED at 30 inches so a board-wide gun does not blanket the map and freeze every closer — the reproduction of the rejected gunline-hold passivity that cap is built to avoid.

simulator.am_chaff_staging.rule_name: Advance move + Charge phase eligibility (10e Core Rules) — Astra Militarum chaff staging scope-widening
simulator.am_chaff_staging.quoted_text: If a unit Advances, then until the end of the turn, that unit cannot shoot or declare a charge. ... A unit cannot be selected to declare a charge if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.
simulator.am_chaff_staging.trigger: gate SWEG_AM_CHAFF_STAGING=1 (default OFF; unset or '0' is the byte-identical kill-switch), on an Astra Militarum attacker that strategy._is_chaff_unit classifies as cheap chaff (per-model points cost under fifteen and no CHARACTER keyword) AND SWEG_AM_STAGING is itself active for the moving army (the universal SWEG_STAGING gate is '1', or the Astra Militarum scoped staging gate is on — SWEG_AM_STAGING is ADOPTED default-on, so this widening is live by default whenever it is switched on); the same EXPOSED / cannot-act-this-turn / no-friendly-mass-committing test that Battle._staging_decision already applies to every non-chaff unit.
simulator.am_chaff_staging.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; the same core-rules grounding as simulator.staging_discipline above (Advancing forfeits both shooting and the charge). This is a SCOPE-WIDENING of that already-adopted staging mechanism onto Astra Militarum's own cheap chaff, not a new mechanism: the read-only Emperor's Children crater diagnostic (docs/_EC_CRATER_FINDINGS.md, 160/160 winner-reproduction verified against the standing anchor) found that Battle._staging_decision's override (b) — cheap chaff and screens are exempt from staging because 'screens are supposed to be exposed' — is exactly Astra Militarum's failure mode against Emperor's Children: the army's light infantry (Kasrkin, Tempestus Scions, Cadian Shock Troops), excluded from both this staging exemption's opposite number (simulator.am_advance_discipline) and from staging itself, committed forward unconditionally and repeatedly died before their own activation came up in battle rounds three and four, while Emperor's Children's durable monster-and-character elements consolidated on the survivors and took one-round scoring swings of fourteen to twenty-nine capped victory points (the board-control gap widening every round — 19/62 at round 2 to 15/85 by round 4 across the 128 replayed losses). When the gate is on for an Astra Militarum attacker, code/simulator.py Battle._staging_decision's chaff-exemption early-return is skipped and the unit falls through to the IDENTICAL threat-envelope test every other Astra Militarum unit already gets under SWEG_AM_STAGING: EXPOSED (the would-be sprint destination enters a significant enemy threat envelope), cannot act this turn (Battle._staging_can_act_this_turn), and no friendly mass already poised in the envelope (commit_ready). Three constraints are preserved exactly because the SAME machinery is reused, not a new one built: (1) staging never freezes the body — a staged unit still Normal-moves toward its goal every turn (only the Advance sprint is suppressed, per the shared _stage_suppress path in Battle._do_move); (2) staging never blocks an objective claim — _staging_can_act_this_turn's CAPTURE/STEAL branch commits any unit that can reach the marker this turn (even by Advancing) regardless of exposure, unchanged by this gate; (3) the mass-commit release is preserved — commit_ready (Battle._precompute_staging_envelope) still releases the whole cluster together the moment a friendly mass is poised in the same envelope, so piecemeal-versus-wave stays the operative distinction. Off (default) or any non-Astra-Militarum attacker reproduces strategy._is_chaff_unit's pre-existing unconditional exemption byte-for-byte.
